notes.title: Challenge Levels added!
notes.content:
Hello.
This is SEOHAN from DAID Games.

It's been quite a while since our last update.

In this update, we've fixed most of the issues we gathered from the last festival.

We've also added additional challenge levels.

Here are the main changes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/e3e699b8a5fd136f9767a23484423232a15eb97a.png[/img]
1. Challenge Levels are added.
 - For those of you who are already familiar with this game, it can definitely be easy. Of course, so am I. That's why we've added three difficulty levels for me and heavy users.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/fd81b51e3efc3d645d69591bbf28e2d48e4e5166.png[/img]
2. The concept of the Damush ship has completely changed.
 - The Damush ship was really unattractive, even as the third unlockable ship, so we changed the concept completely. 

3. The structure of the ship upgrade UI has changed.
 - We found that the Resource Status UI was hidden in the Upgrade window, so we've made it visible and changed the internal structure of the Upgrade UI accordingly.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/b563a7c08ce30c9d02d6b9810f03d6b1f21862f1.png[/img]
4. Within the Upgrade UI, the icon of the Reactor Core has changed.
 - We've heard some feedback from first-time players that they can't recognize a Reactor Core by looking at the ONLY symbol. So we've changed the icon so that it's the same as it was when they were obtained.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/8ed19e0c8c6992ef2bb4257e80a19e8029621ed6.png[/img]
5. The structure of the Lab UI has also changed.
 - The reason is the same as in #2.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/6a98cf22b89545567e5d6583d06392d5dc047769.png[/img]
6. Before casting an obstacle skill, the radius is now displayed in advance.
 - The radius of obstacle skills was not visible and had to be calculated in advance. So we've improved this.
7. Shortcuts for selecting ships have been added.
 - There were shortcuts for selecting a ship's weapons or movement, but there was no shortcut for selecting a ship, which was inconvenient. So we've improved this.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/dcf3ad26be4968223d69ccf8b0b7c7edc63ba49a.gif[/img]
8. The Dark Zone event now shows the changes.
 - If you transformed a Reactor Core, it was too inconvenient to see what it transformed into. So we've improved this.


* p.s.
 For those of you who played version 1.0.0 and 2.0.0, you probably know that the game is very different now.
 Sure, it's lost some of its flavor, but I definitely feel like it's more fun than ever before. We've spent a lot of time since launch working on it, and thanks to your feedback and the positive reviews. of course, we've gotten to this point.

 We wish our game could have been loved by more people,

 But we're sure it's already received more than enough attention.

 We will repay you with more fun games in the future.

 Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

notes.title: New mode released!
notes.content:
Hello, this is SEOHAN from DAID Games.

We've finally finished updating the new mode, “Temporal Rewind: Inviolable”.

This new mode is the "Boss Run" for all boss encounters.
We apologize for the delay, as we tried to get it ready as quickly as possible, but we kept getting bugs with every playthrough.

We're sure you'll have fun with this new mode.
We've played it many times and it's definitely more fun than the original mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/2be024708358392bd037699e681f58fb7649e8ba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/cec28524a9cc31f94c1589653e7ae3c592ce638b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/8300a1e873723f97d8398ba3e449e0dfc4d7c7ed.png[/img]

Winning a boss battle does not recover health for ally ships.
This could be more roguelike.

[b]Hopefully, prepare your best ships to face bosses that have new gimmicks.[/b]

Other key changes in this update include
- The carrier's health has been adjusted.
- The cost of carrier repairs in the Lab has also been adjusted.
- The health, skillset, and gimmick of the third planet's boss has been changed.
- The amount of Stellar and Udtmos energy in each mission's rewards has been adjusted.

* Next update

- Difficulty will be added to “Temporal Rewind: Inviolable”.
- 1 ally ship concept will be changed.
- We'll be fixing all kinds of things you've been telling us about.

* p.s. I think we've fixed what we can, but if you find any bugs, wrong descriptions, mistranslations, or other issues, please contact us on Steam Community or Discord and we'll fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: Last Update: v3.0.0
notes.content:
hello.
This is a developer SEOHAN from DAID Games.
First, I'd like to apologize for taking so long to post.

It's been a long time since we've been thinking about how to make the game more fun.

A lot has changed.
I think the biggest difference is the change to carrier instead of base.
(More differences can be seen in a trailer on the shop page.)

More has changed than hasn't, so here are the main things that haven't changed.
- Existed grid, turn-based battle
- The way to mount reactor cores to power up the ship
- The way to obtain energy to upgrade the ship
- The way to follow the route to reach the final stage

Finally, the following features will be added with the public release.
- 10~20 reactor cores
- Challenge mode up to level 3 (=Temporal Rewind)
- Improved visibility of tiles (it's still a bit hard to see when installable weapons are overlapped, we'll try to make it easier to see)

In 2023, we'd like to sincerely thank you for playing our game.
We'll see you next year on January 31st for the full release.

notes.title: Renewal: v2.0.0
notes.content:
Dear players, this is SEOHAN, Director of The Pair Annihilation.

I'm writing to update you on today's v2.0.0 release and to make an announcement about future updates.

First of all, we apologize that this was supposed to be the end of June, but we didn't get to say hello until July.

[b]Renewal[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/863180e5a80dd523e7c46c530f47f691daa64647.gif[/img]
- The inherent gameplay of grid and turn  based strategy remains intact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/e0668d73aa525303ba626d83e36b03fba1ed2ca1.gif[/img]
- Instead of fighting on multiple battlefields with enemies invading every turn in a stellar system, you now fight one mission on one battlefield.
- Satellite development has been removed.

- Added or changed armaments, reactor cores, planet skills, and more.

[b]Next updates[/b]
- Playing from about round 9 onward feels like rehashing what player has already done. That's a future task that we need to finish. So as player enters the later rounds of the game, we'll be adding more missions, encounters, and so on.

* There will be ongoing bug fixes, balance patches, new reactor cores, ships, and more.

07.2023: Adding and changing Steam Achievements
08.2023: Battlefield(=map), mission diversification

notes.title: Renewal Notice: v2.0.0
notes.content:
Hello players, this is SEOHAN, Director of The Pair Annihilation.

First of all, thanks to everyone who played.
I'm writing to let you know what's changed since our last update notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/3f2ff1ffae1a01757f437dcba09939bb137011e0.gif[/img]
* Summary
1. Instead of going from turn 1 to turn 150 all at once, it will be broken up by one round.
2. No more multiple battlefields at the same time. The enemies are non-stop for 150 turns,

* Explanation
1. Instead of going from turn 1 to turn 150 all at once, it will be broken up by one round.
- If you're in the middle of your first game, and you feel like you've had enough, it's usually around 90th turn. The rest of the playthrough was no more unique, just boring. The enemies are non-stop for 150 turns, and you have to drag the game out without any rest. The game is saved at every turn, but there are no game-breaking point that could be called "save points". So to improve this, we're going to separate combat / production, repair and combat phase - preparation phase.

2. No more multiple battlefields at the same time.
- There were multiple battlefields, but as I said before, they have only uncharacteristic environment. This simply broke up the map into multiple parts, which was just distracting. Also, the large number of planets was an issue as we were trying to plan the separation of the combat and preparation phases above.
 So we are will change it so that players only play on one map.

The graphics and story will remain the same, but the root system have to be changed, so we're re-implementing the game's code from the ground up.
 But we promise to have a draft at least by June.

Thanks.

tags.feature: Instead of going from turn 1 to turn 150 all at once, it will be broken up by one round.
No more multiple battlefields at the same time.
So we are will change it so that players only play on one map.

notes.title: Director's Note: v2.0.0
notes.content:
Hello players, this is SEOHAN, Director of The Pair Annihilation.

First of all, I'd like to thank everyone who has played even a little bit.
I'm writing to tell you about the direction of our development.

The current game is about defending a minimum of 7 and as many as 10 planets or star.
Each planet has a primary environment and we had planned that this would be the planet's characteristic.
However, it's hard to see much difference between planets, as the environments changes only values not significant impact on the game.

Because of this, the current state of play seems that we've given you a few environments that only change the values, and increased the number of maps by 7 or more.
Multiple uncharacteristic maps are cluttered and boring.

Also, in the defence element of stopping enemies moving from the left end to the right end, making it turn-based rather than real-time make you even less to think about.

Therefore, the direction of development going forward is as follows

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/33eb75943c405fc935571403468c76b48ade33da.png[/img]
1. Changes to the way that planet takes damage to deepen the turn-based strategy.
 - Each planet's battlefield now has space stations instead of satellites. Some can be developed and moved, while others cannot.
 - If all stations on the battlefield are destroyed, the planet is destroyed (or occupied).
 - As a result, enemies will not simply move to the right, rather they will move in 4 directions and try to destroy the station.

2. The planet's environment becomes more characteristic.
- Rather than a simple gimmick of reducing the travel distance by 1 numerically, it might increase the travel distance only in certain cells, or something else entirely.

This update will take more time than the last update, and I can promise you that it will be available in May at the latest.

notes.title: Notice: Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
Until the first week of May, the following updates will be released.

1. In-game dialog for specific situations is added.
- Since it's the same playthrough from the start to the final boss, we realized that we needed any features to keep gamers from getting bored while trying to reach the final boss. To make the goal of "Defend the stellar system." more challenging, we'll be adding in-game dialog for specific situations. Sometimes this will come as an alert when an enemy infiltrates a planet, sometimes it will come as a mid-boss encounter.

2. The function of changing the game's hotkeys and the visualization of the hotkeys  is added.
- As there are multiple battlefields, you'll need to move between them to defend against enemies as you progress through the round. During this process, we realized that the battlefield navigation is a bit inconvenient, so we're going to improve the current <0> to <9> navigation by allowing you to change the keys to suit your convenience.
 We are also going to visualize the corresponding control keys on each UI so that you can immediately know which key to press.
- We are also going to add hotkeys for selecting a ship on the battlefield and moving, attacking, and interstellar warping that ship, as there are no separate hotkeys for these actions.

3. Game speed change is added.
- We realize that not all gamers will want to play at the current game speed, so we are also going to add three different game speeds - "Normal," "Little Faster," and "Fast" - that gamers can adjust in the settings window.

Your feedback and ideas are always helpful with us!
Thank you!

notes.title: Release: Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863700/5846004f83aebed79d2a632df51c86345eef2f37.png[/img]

[b]The human race had a victory.
But never can stop the end.

Must choose.
Whether to face the end as it is,
Or to rewind the time and challenge again.[/b]

In this v1.2 update, we've added a "Temporal Rewind" mode for "perfectly" defending the stellar systems!
Here's what's new and changed in the 1st Temporal Rewind.

- Obstacles on Battlefield and many others things are randomly generated.

- The size of the enemy forces increases.

- Enemy attacks deal an additional damage to ally's satellite.

- New system is added: Emergency Research

- New ally and enemy ships are added.

- New Reactor Cores are added.

Also in this update, we've added the following patches.
- Some ship stats and concepts have been readjusted.
- Added a new feature "Dashboard".
- Improved some bugs in the game.

Your feedback and ideas are always helpful with us!
Thank you!
